svg.title: heavy-committer — berserker, journeyman — a MainQuest character sheet derived from public GitHub activity
svg.desc: Class from the shape of contribution activity, not its volume. Sigil is generated from the login and never changes.
svg.metadata: Heraldic charge "birch-trees" by caro-asercion from game-icons.net (https://game-icons.net), licensed CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/). Recoloured and composited into a heraldic sigil by MainQuest.
